name: @gaiadesk/consent
description: GaiaDesk's consent step, in your app's own webview: a themed, localized, accessible <gaiadesk-consent> element (and a React wrapper) that shows what support will see, offers per-session choices and records a consent receipt.
author: GaiaDesk <noreply@gaiadesk.net>

scripts.typecheck: npm run gen && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-timeout=20000 dist-test/locales.test.js dist-test/options.test.js dist-test/wording.test.js dist-test/element.test.js dist-test/web-bridge.test.js dist-test/react.test.js
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
